title: the preview of a settings change prints no unchanged line, so a token in a user hook or in env never reaches the terminal
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D8 (setup hook, defect N-17): jitso registers its guard in the project's .claude/settings.json without clobbering anything
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-17, setup hook). `.claude/settings.json` can hold `env` values and other hooks' commands with tokens (AGENTS.md rule 1). jitso only adds lines here, so the diff of a settings file prints zero context lines: the unified diff has its `---`/`+++` headers and `@@` hunks but never the user's own entries (`TOKEN-CANARY-7`, `ENV-CANARY-9`). Since N-25 the guard also has a third PreToolUse group, `Write|Edit|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit`. The oracle has no `setup` command: it answers `unknown command "setup"` on stderr with exit 2 and prints nothing on stdout, so every expectation that needs this output or file effect FAILS on it.

stdout.regex: jitso setup hook: dry run, nothing written\n$
